text:
Sam K: quick q — i'm building a small 'microledger' sandbox for cost attribution in the console. goal: let product teams see per-invocation marginal cost + how cache savings were split across routes. any red flags?
Maya R: love the idea. main UX risk is showing savings that look 'free' to users. need to surface provenance (prefetch vs hotpath). :thinking:
Jordan P: agree. also need to decide if ledger entries are causal (real-time) or aggregated (batch). batch is cheaper but confusing for canaries.
Asha Ops: FWIW infra prefers batch updates every 5m for throughput. real-time spikes will be approximated.
devx-bot: deploy queued for canary -> microledger-service:v0.3.2 (eta ~10m) :rocket:
Sam K: thanks — UX idea: show two numbers — "apparent savings" (what tenant sees) and "allocated savings" (how system split credits). small tooltip with rule used.
Maya R: +1. Can we avoid per-token math on the frontend? do server calculate and return a 3-line breakdown.
Jordan P: server returns rows like: [model_sku, inv_cost, cache_savings_claim] and a trace_id for lineage. sample proto: ```json
{"model_sku":"redwood-ggml-70b","inv_cost":0.0042,"cache_credit":0.0015,"trace":"t=abc123"}
```
Asha Ops: question: when two routes hit same KV cache entry, do we split by last-touch or by token-shape? last-touch is simpler but unfair for multi-tenant prefetch.
Sam K: prototype used proportional split by prompt-length + recency weight (0.7 recency, 0.3 prompt-shape). happy to iterate.
Maya R: can we add a 'confidence' tag on the ledger row (high/medium/low)? helps product teams triage weird savings.
Jordan P: yes. confidence = function(samples, overlap_count). low if overlap_count>1 and samples<10.
Sam K: UX question: how to surface this in dashboard? a microledger tab per-tenant? or integrated into per-route cost card?
Maya R: prefer integrated card with an expandable 'microledger detail' flyout. avoids UI clutter and keeps context.
Asha Ops: for quotas: if allocated savings reduce token billing, must not allow evasion. tie adjustments to an invoice-preview stage and show audit rows.
Sam K: noted — ledger rows will have immutable audit_id and we keep pre- and post-allocation snapshots.
Jordan P: operationally, we need a reconciliation job weekly to catch drift between allocated credits and actual infra billing. detect >1% drift -> alert.
Sam K: thinking about API shape for the console: `/microledger/query?tenant=foo&range=24h&granularity=1h` returns list of ledger rows + repro tips. anyone object to that pattern?
Maya R: fine. make sure we include `explainable_rule` string so frontend can render the tooltip without another call.
Asha Ops: also add `raw_refs` array (trace ids) but restrict to internal role. non-admins get aggregated refs only.
Jordan P: dev question: do we stamp rows with routing_policy_id? that lets us attribute hit to routing decisions (sticky vs cost-aware).
Sam K: yes — include routing_policy_id, model_variant, and route_tag. helps when we want to simulate 'what if routing changed'.
Maya R: rollout UX: feature-flag microledger in console behind a beta toggle. default off for accounts > enterprise until we validate.
Sam K: makes sense. can we test with synthetic tenants in staging to validate allocation heuristics?
Jordan P: i'll spin a traffic sim that generates overlapping prefetch/hotpath patterns, dump expected ledger and compare.
Asha Ops: note: add rate-limiting on the query API (1r/s per tenant) — the console will poll.
Sam K: final: do we want to expose a simple cost-whatif slider (e.g., change recency weight from 0.7->0.3) so PMs can see effect?
Maya R: yes, but only in sandbox mode and as a read-only projection. do not apply to billing.
Sam K: perfect. i'll push the proto and a short RFC. thanks y'all. :heart:
Jordan P: thanks — will drop sim results in this thread.
devx-bot: deploy successful -> microledger-service:v0.3.2 :white_check_mark: 
Sam K: (follow-up) putting the RFC at https://redwood.internal/rfcs/microledger, ping me for reviews.
